signature algorithm

  • CURIE: gmeow:signatureAlgorithm
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/signatureAlgorithm
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/trust

The algorithm used for a signature (e.g. rsa-sha256, ed25519).

Structure

Property shape: datatype property; gmeow:CryptographicSignature -> rdfs:Literal; functional
